alerts-bot: INCIDENT detected: us-west-2 inference nodes reporting tail latency spike
alerts-bot: p95 jumped from ~420ms -> 1.2s; p99 ~1.8s; streaming stalls increasing; KV cache eviction rate +650% across shard group A. Auto-escalation to oncall (p1). :rotating_light:

Raj P. (oncall): on it. observed impact on streaming clients? any customer reports?

Maria C. (support): @Raj P. several customers reported partial streaming stalls, timeouts on long-chat sessions (user-facing token delays). CS says 3 enterprise tenants saw >30% failed responses in last 10m.

Emma L.: metric dump from the runtime (last 5m):
```
metric:kv_cache/evictions: 11235 -> 83200 (5m)
metric:kv_cache/prefill_queue_len: 24 -> 980
metric:kv_cache/decode_throughput_rps: 3200 -> 410
metric:inference/p95: 0.42 -> 1.22
metric:inference/p99: 0.88 -> 1.79
logs: streaming_tail_errors: "write stall detected, kv prefill wait > 200ms"
```

Emma L.: looks like prefill is piling up (prefill queue up x40) while decode workers starved -> decode vs prefill imbalance. Evictions spike when prefill bursts allocate many slabs and then eviction floods.

Sophie (SRE): confirmed shard A slab allocation rate high. Heap/Slab stats: hot slabs filling, small-object fragmentation increasing. Paging observed on two hosts (page faults up). Might be combined memory pressure + GC hiccups on prefill service.

Raj P. (oncall): immediate mitigations we can try now (low-risk first):
- reduce PREFILL_CONCURRENCY for prefill workers to slow prefill arrival rate
- enable temporary strict LRU eviction threshold to avoid thrashing
- if needed, failover a small % of traffic to us-east to relieve us-west pressure

Emma L.: patch ready to flip: set env PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=4 on prefill-deployer and scale down prefill replica from 12 -> 6. Also toggling KV_EVICTION_MODE=aggressive-temporary.

Sophie (SRE): rolling change plan:
1) Patch prefill config via config-service (canary 2 nodes)
2) monitor decode throughput & eviction rate 2m windows
3) if p99 improves < 1s and evictions drop 70%, proceed full rollout
4) else, rollback and fallback to model-variant small (ram-costly but lower latency)

Raj P. (oncall): go for canary. Emma, deploy canary and post command logs here.

Emma L.: running canary now:
```
# canary deploy commands
kubectl set env deploy/prefill-service PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=4 -n prod-us-west-2
kubectl scale deploy/prefill-service --replicas=6 -n prod-us-west-2
kubectl set env deploy/prefill-service KV_EVICTION_MODE=aggressive-temporary -n prod-us-west-2
```

Emma L.: canary applied to nodes id {usw2-node-14,usw2-node-15}. watching metrics.

(2m later)

Emma L.: quick snapshot after canary:
```
metric:kv_cache/evictions: shardA 82k -> 28k
metric:kv_cache/prefill_queue_len: 980 -> 220
metric:kv_cache/decode_throughput_rps: 410 -> 2100
metric:inference/p95: 1.22 -> 0.58
metric:inference/p99: 1.79 -> 0.95
streaming_tail_errors: down ~75% from peak
```

Sophie (SRE): good signal. eviction rate dropped and decode throughput recovering. no paging seen on canary hosts. recommend roll to remaining nodes with 30s stagger.

Raj P. (oncall): rolling to remaining prefill replicas now. notifying CS/ops to update impacted customers. Maria, can you post a short update?

Maria C. (support): posted PSR updates to tenants: "We are mitigating a latency issue in us-west; streaming interruptions are improving. Engineering applied a temporary throttling config. We will follow-up with postmortem."

Emma L.: full rollout completed. final metrics: p95 0.48, p99 0.9, evictions normalized. continuing to monitor for 30m.

Sophie (SRE): follow-ups for postmortem:
- root cause: prefill concurrency allowed bursts that exceeded slab allocation policy under mixed workload -> fragmentation -> eviction storms + paging
- short-term: PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=4 + aggressive-temporary eviction profile
- medium-term: implement adaptive prefill rate limiter driven by current slab free percentage and decode backlog; improve slab allocator to reduce fragmentation for small objects
- long-term: add backpressure path in router to avoid catastrophic prefill when decode pool is saturated; kinetic cache compaction job nightly

Raj P. (oncall): customer impact assessment summary to include in incident report:
- impact window: ~10:13:24 -> 10:26:08 UTC (about 13.5m)
- visible symptoms: streaming stalls, increased p95/p99, ~3 enterprise tenants reported >30% failures during window
- mitigation: config throttle + eviction mode => restored within ~6m of first mitigation canary

Kevin H. (next): taking handoff at 10:40 UTC. notes: keep PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=4 until an autoscaler/adaptive limiter is in place. will own postmortem and coordinate with runtime team for allocator change.

Raj P. (oncall): thanks team. tagging for follow-up: @Sophie @Emma L. @Kevin H. please add links to the postmortem doc and any PRs here when available. :thumbsup:

alerts-bot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Incident channel will remain open for postmortem coordination.
